summary: Fossil is a distributed version control system that integrates project management tools directly into the core application. It provides built-in wiki and bug tracking capabilities alongside standard source code management. This approach bundles documentation and issue history with the codebase itself.
goodFor: It is well-suited for solo developers or small teams who want an all-in-one project management and version control environment without configuring separate web applications.
watchOut: The ecosystem and community are considerably smaller than git-based alternatives, which may limit third-party integrations and troubleshooting resources.
deployNotes: Being written in C, it typically runs as a lightweight standalone binary or via CGI behind a reverse proxy for TLS termination. You will need to ensure persistent storage for the underlying SQLite-based repository files.
